svg.text: Request Execution Flow: Step 0 Concurrent Data Fusion -> Layer 1 Regression -> Layer 2 Vectorized GA
PredictRequest: centroid(lat, lon), polygon(GeoJSON), area_ha, current_crop,
ProjectRecalcRequest: centroid, current_crop, soil_type, region_id, planting_month,
• Applies AppEEARS L1/L2 override if ready
• Defaults to flat LS=1.0 if offline
If 'soil_type' was NOT explicitly passed in
Scaled by WHC & 0.90 ECOSTRESS ESI mult
• Heat Stress (peak Tmax, >35C mos, VPD, frost)
Output: Layer1RegressionOutput -> season_water_budgets_mm (3,), soil_profile, region_profile, oversupply_penalty_vector (N_crops,), overall_risk_score
Single NumPy fancy-index pass on lookup_store.crop_matrix (N, 6):
N balance + (1 - C*K*LS) erosion cover + pest break + pH buffer - cover overuse
Seasonal budget deficit compliance (budget_score) + mean drought tolerance
Net margin (water/pest/pH yield mults, -22% oversupply) + 65% legume N credit
for Strategy B and Strategy C.
• N carryover (65% legume credit), fertilizer_n_kg_ha, SOM delta %
• POST /predict -> Runs GA Steps 1-3 for B & C, simulates A, B, C & sets recommended_strategy = C (if priority=='cost') else B
• POST /predict/project-recalculate -> SKIPS GA Steps 1-3; resolves fixed crop indices + season_overrides -> calls _build_strategy_payload('PROJECT_PLAN')
request_id, execution_ms, location, area_ha, inputs, climate (36 monthly records),
risk, strategies [A, B, C], recommended_strategy, optimizer
totals (water_use, deficit, N_balance, SOM_delta, margin, fitness), warnings
